## 1. Voice & Tone

### 1.1 Core Principles

Write like a patient instructor. Never talk down to the reader.

Contractions are fine in most pieces.

## 2. Grammar & Usage

### 2.1 Serial Comma

Always use the serial comma. No exceptions.

### 2.2 Capitalization

#### 2.2.1 Headings

Headings use sentence case.

## 3. Punctuation

### Em Dashes

Close up em dashes.

## 4. Structure & Organization

### 4.1 Article Structure

Open with the point, then the steps.

## 5. SEO & Discoverability

### 5.1 Keyword Usage

Use the main keyword in the first heading.

## 6. Citations & Attribution

### 6.1 Source Citation

Link to the original source.

## 7. Word Choice & Style Preferences

### 7.1 Preferred Terms

Use "email", not "e-mail".

### 8.1 Accuracy

Check every number against its source.
